nodes.label: Multipole fixed by the orbital jump and the parity
nodes.rationale: The map states exactly the part the coordinates support and no more: the lowest multipole whose parity matches, read from one-electron Delta-l on Lambda_9 (M1, E1, E2, E3), with only M1 (814 cells) and E1 (840 cells) occurring on the base build because the caps hold |Delta l| <= 1.

nodes.label: |Delta J| is inexpressible: the tower carries no source J
nodes.rationale: Lambda builds J on the target side only, so the finer |Delta J| <= multipole-order half of the electric-dipole rule, which needs both endpoints' J, is simply not expressible at any level of the tower and is declared missing rather than approximated.

nodes.label: Refusal when |Delta l| exceeds three
nodes.rationale: The rule refuses rather than guesses, which is one of the two conditions demanded of any rule: agree where agreement is known (nine textbook classifications reproduced) and be capable of returning a failure.
